sources.title: Qwen3-8B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3-8B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑8B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual base language model with 8 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.
